title: Retrieve a syntactically valid but unknown job identifier

source.observation: The same response was observed when retrieving a job after successful dismissal.

must: Expose the parsed NoSuchJob problem together with status, headers, final URL, and raw body.
Keep an existing caller-side job record available for diagnostics.
must_not: Treat an HTTP 404 response as a transport failure with no response.
Guess whether the job expired, was dismissed, belonged to another user, or never existed.
